name: Disintegrate
description: The first clip crumbles into fine dust from one side, its grains blown away by the wind and fading out, revealing the second clip underneath. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: particle_size
params.description: Size of the dust grains, in frame heights

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction in which the wind blows the dust (x right, y up)

params.name: spread
params.description: How far the dust flies and scatters before it fades out
